name: Li Xuefeng
current_role: Vice Chairman and controlling shareholder (~26%), Qifeng New Material Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 002521), Shandong
profile: Li Xuefeng built Shandong Qifeng Group into Qifeng New Material, a Zibo-based maker of decorative base paper and specialty paper listed in Shenzhen. He chaired the company from 2004 and in June 2025 handed the chairmanship to Li Andong for age-related reasons, staying on as Vice Chairman and remaining the controlling shareholder.
interesting_fact: Qifeng New Material specialises in decorative base paper, the printed surface paper laminated onto furniture panels and flooring; Li remains its actual controller with about 26% of shares.
notes: Very low English-language profile. Best route is likely via the company's board secretary / IR office listed in Qifeng New Material's SZSE filings (stock code 002521). The name is common; a different Li Xuefeng works at Comba Telecom.

name: KPD Sigamani
current_role: Managing Director and promoter, K.P.R. Mill Ltd (Coimbatore); heads the apparel division
profile: KPD Sigamani is one of the founding brothers of the KPR Group, the Coimbatore textile conglomerate started by his elder brother K.P. Ramasamy as a power-loom business in 1971. As Managing Director of K.P.R. Mill he runs the export-focused apparel division of a vertically integrated yarn-to-garment maker that also has sugar, ethanol, wind and solar power. Shareholders re-appointed him MD in 2025.
interesting_fact: KPR Mill runs a long-running in-factory education programme (since 1998) that lets its mostly women workers earn school-level, degree, vocational and nursing qualifications while employed; tens of thousands have completed courses.
deep_cut_fact: He trained as a mathematician: the group describes him as a postgraduate in mathematics, and he is credited with a major role in project execution for KPR's expansions.
notes: The published email is KPR Mill's investor grievance-redressal address (company secretary), not a personal contact. Chairman K.P. Ramasamy is the group's public face; Sigamani gives few interviews.

name: Neil S Subin
current_role: President & CIO, MILFAM LLC (single-family office); director of NextNav Inc., Alimco Financial and Frontiersman Holdings; board member, Type One Energy
profile: Neil Subin is a New York special-situations and activist investor who founded Trendex Capital Management (distressed companies) and later chaired Broadbill Investment Partners. He now runs MILFAM LLC, a single-family office, and sits on the board of NextNav (3D geolocation / PNT) since 2022; SEC filings show 10%+ stakes in Optimum Communications and Gulf Coast Ultra Deep Royalty Trust.
interesting_fact: He has repeatedly served on creditor or shareholder committees in bankruptcies and has been a director of Federal-Mogul, Primus Telecommunications, Komag and Centrus Energy, the US enriched-uranium fuel supplier.
deep_cut_fact: He sits on the board of Type One Energy, a fusion-power startup developing stellarator reactors, bringing his earlier nuclear-fuel board experience from Centrus Energy.
notes: Strong fit for an energy podcast (fusion via Type One Energy, nuclear fuel via Centrus, ultra-deep gas royalties). Very private family-office investor; no personal channels found. Best route likely via Type One Energy or NextNav investor relations.

name: Umesh Agarwal
current_role: Director, Haldiram Snacks Pvt Ltd (Delhi branch of Haldiram's); also director of Haldi Ram Products and Haldiram's Marketing
profile: Umesh (Kumar) Agarwal is a member of the Delhi branch of the Agarwal family behind Haldiram's, the snack brand that grew from a 1937 Bikaner sweet shop. Company filings list him (DIN 00011472) as a director of Haldiram Snacks and related entities; the Delhi business has since merged into Haldiram Snacks Food, which took investment from Temasek in 2025.
interesting_fact: In an October 2026 interview he argued that 'consistency is not created by writing a standard' and that food safety at Haldiram's has to be a daily culture rather than something prepared for before inspections.
notes: Several Umesh Agarwals are linked to Haldiram's in press (Umesh Kumar Agarwal of Haldiram's Marketing; 'Umesh Madhu Agarwal', interviewed by Zomato's Deepinder Goyal in 2024). Filings tie DIN 00011472 to Haldiram Snacks; confirm which person Hurun means before outreach. Family is private; corporate channel is the realistic route.

name: Lee Miller
current_role: Shareholder (~12%) of StartEngine Crowdfunding, Inc. via The Lee Miller Trust; no public operating role found
profile: An SEC Schedule 13G/A (Feb 2024) shows Lee Miller, a US citizen, beneficially owning about 4.2 million StartEngine shares (12.0%), mostly through The Lee Miller Trust, plus Series Seed preferred and stock options. StartEngine is the Burbank-based equity-crowdfunding platform co-founded by Howard Marks and chairman Ron Miller. No further public biography could be found.
interesting_fact: The holding includes Series Seed preferred shares, indicating a very early-stage investor in StartEngine.
notes: Not to be confused with StartEngine co-founder/chairman Ron Miller. Essentially no public profile; the 13G lists a c/o business address (FPG, Inc., Encino). Only realistic route is via StartEngine investor relations. Low priority.

name: Gundavaram Vanaja Devi
current_role: Whole-time Director and co-promoter, Kaveri Seed Company Ltd (Secunderabad); re-appointed for 2026-2031
profile: G. Vanaja Devi is a co-promoter of Kaveri Seed Company, the Hyderabad-area hybrid seed maker (cotton, maize, rice, vegetables) led by chairman and MD G.V. Bhaskar Rao. She has been on the board since the company was incorporated in 1986 and oversees CSR and community development while assisting the MD with administration; shareholders were asked in 2026 to extend her term to 2031.
interesting_fact: Kaveri Seed has been named six times by Forbes Asia among its 'Best Under a Billion' companies.
deep_cut_fact: She has been a director since the company's incorporation on 27 August 1986 and heads Kaveri's CSR and community-development work, which the board credits for its rural-empowerment programmes.
notes: Company contacts only (company secretary and general info). Very low media profile; chairman G.V. Bhaskar Rao is the public face.

name: N Sitaram Shetty
current_role: Chairman / whole-time director, Shankaranarayana Constructions Pvt Ltd (SNC), Bengaluru
profile: Dr. N. Sitaram (Narayana Sitaram) Shetty leads the board of Shankaranarayana Constructions, a Bengaluru infrastructure contractor that builds dams, power plants, aqueducts, tunnels and canals. With over three decades in construction, he is credited with steering SNC towards energy and water projects; Vybhav Shetty is Managing Director.
interesting_fact: Under his leadership SNC repositioned itself around energy and water, building dams, power plants, tunnels and irrigation canals.
deep_cut_fact: Before becoming a construction magnate he trained as a medical doctor; the company describes him as 'a professional Doctor'.
notes: Good fit for energy/water infrastructure theme. Company website currently carries injected gambling spam (appears hacked), so verify contacts before use. sncbgr@ is the published general company inbox.

name: Christopher William Degnan
current_role: Former Chief Revenue Officer, Snowflake; now a go-to-market adviser, fund investor and Stanford GSB lecturer (MEDDIC course)
profile: Chris Degnan was Snowflake's first sales hire and spent 11 years building its sales organisation, serving as CRO from zero to roughly $3.5B in revenue under four CEOs. Before Snowflake he sold enterprise software at Informatica and Covalent, spent about eight years at EMC (rising to AVP West) and was VP Western Region at Aveksa. He has stepped back from operating roles to advise founders and invest.
interesting_fact: He brought EMC's MEDDPICC sales-qualification discipline to Snowflake, and now teaches a MEDDIC course at Stanford Graduate School of Business.
deep_cut_fact: Early in his career he was told he would never be a VP of Sales, let alone a CRO. He began in EMC's mid-market commercial sales team and spent about eight years there learning under sales trainer John McMahon.
notes: Data-infrastructure fit (Snowflake). Has done several long-form podcasts (First Round, Operators), so receptive to interviews. Could not confirm exact date he left the CRO post (web-search budget exhausted); First Round now titles him 'Former CRO'.

name: J Scott Kirby
current_role: CEO, United Airlines Holdings; director, CVS Health
profile: Scott Kirby is CEO of United Airlines (since May 2020), after serving as United's president from 2016 and earlier as president of US Airways and American Airlines. An Air Force Academy graduate in computer science and operations research, he began as a Pentagon budget analyst and at Sabre before joining America West in 1995. He also chairs the Star Alliance chief executive board.
interesting_fact: He has led three major US airlines as president (US Airways, American, United) and in December 2020 became chairman of the Star Alliance chief executive board.
deep_cut_fact: As an Air Force Academy cadet he learned he would never be a military pilot when an instructor had him close his eyes and fly straight and level in an F-4 over the Gulf of Mexico; when he opened them he was in a 30-degree left bank.
notes: High-profile, heavily handled by United corporate communications; route via United media relations newsroom.

name: H Andrew DeFerrari
current_role: Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (also Principal Accounting Officer), Dycom Industries
profile: Drew DeFerrari has been CFO of Dycom Industries, the Florida-based contractor that builds and maintains fiber, wireless and utility networks for telecom carriers, since April 2008. He joined Dycom in 2004 as Controller from Ernst & Young, became Chief Accounting Officer in 2005, and added Principal Accounting Officer duties in January 2024.
interesting_fact: He has been Dycom's CFO since April 2008, succeeding Richard Dunn: roughly 18 years in the role, an unusually long tenure for a public-company CFO.
deep_cut_fact: He started at Dycom in July 2004 as Controller after a stint as a senior audit manager at Ernst & Young, rising to CFO less than four years later.
notes: Fiber/telecom infrastructure angle (Dycom builds fiber networks, relevant to data-center connectivity). info@ is the company's general inbox; the IR contact page blocks automated access, check it manually.

name: Lawrence Otto Klein
current_role: Chief Executive Officer and director, Oruka Therapeutics (Nasdaq: ORKA)
profile: Lawrence Klein, PhD, is CEO of Oruka Therapeutics, which develops long-acting monoclonal antibodies for plaque psoriasis and other inflammatory skin diseases, aiming for complete clearance with one or two doses a year. He previously spent seven years at CRISPR Therapeutics as Chief Business Officer and then COO, was a partner at Versant Ventures, and earlier an associate partner at McKinsey.
interesting_fact: He was part of CRISPR Therapeutics' leadership for seven years, helping set its strategy and partnerships as it became one of the best-known gene-editing companies.
deep_cut_fact: Before business he was a scientist: his Stanford PhD in biophysics focused on T-cell immunology. Oruka's name blends words meaning 'skin' and 'restoration'.
notes: Biotech, not an energy/data-center fit. No direct email found; IR site blocks automated access, so check Oruka press releases manually for the IR/media contact.

name: Nello Mainolfi
current_role: Founder, President & CEO, Kymera Therapeutics (Nasdaq: KYMR), Watertown, MA
profile: Nello Mainolfi, PhD, founded Kymera Therapeutics, a pioneer of targeted protein degradation that makes oral 'degrader' drugs, with a focus on immunology. Under him Kymera has raised close to $3 billion and partnered with major pharma companies; in October 2026 it reported positive Phase 1 results for KT-579. He trained at Imperial College London and Scripps Research and began his career at Novartis.
interesting_fact: He has authored more than 100 publications and patents, and says his favourite part of the day is digging into emerging data.
deep_cut_fact: At Novartis he led cross-functional teams that identified several investigational medicines, including iptacopan, the first-in-class factor B inhibitor later approved by the FDA.
notes: Founder-entrepreneur story (built Kymera from scratch, 'Ten Years of Kymera' blog). Biotech rather than energy; best route is the Kymera contact form, Media option.

name: Nicolau Carvalho Esteves
current_role: Co-Chairman of the Board, Afya Ltd (Nasdaq: AFYA), Brazil's leading medical-education group
profile: Nicolau Carvalho Esteves, a qualified orthopedist, founded and ran private medical and higher-education institutions in Brazil, starting with ITPAC in Tocantins (CEO 1999-2016), then IPTAN and ITPAC Porto. These formed the base of Afya, which listed on Nasdaq in 2019 with Bertelsmann as partner; the Esteves family were the controlling shareholders until Bertelsmann took control. He has been Afya's co-chairman since 2022.
interesting_fact: A practising-doctor-turned-entrepreneur, he went from orthopedics to building one of Brazil's largest networks of medical schools, now controlled by Germany's Bertelsmann.
deep_cut_fact: Besides his medical degree from Faculdade de Medicina de Barbacena, he collected three master's degrees (an MBA from FGV, corporate finance from Fundação Dom Cabral, and an MBA from FEAD) plus a business administration degree.
notes: Based in Brazil; low English-language media profile. Afya IR is the realistic route. Also on the board of Emive Participações (security services) since 2024.

name: Ravi Inukonda
current_role: Chief Financial Officer, DoorDash, Inc.
profile: Ravi Inukonda has been DoorDash's CFO since March 2023, after joining in 2018 as VP of Finance and Strategy. He previously ran finance for Uber Eats (2015-2018), and earlier worked at Accel-KKR, Battery Ventures and Goldman Sachs investment banking.
interesting_fact: He was Head of Finance at Uber Eats during its build-out (2015-2018) before moving to rival DoorDash, where he rose to CFO.
deep_cut_fact: He trained as an engineer: a B.E. in Chemical Engineering from BITS Pilani and an M.S. in Computer Science from Clemson University, before an MBA at MIT Sloan.
notes: Low personal media profile beyond earnings calls. DoorDash IR is the published route.

name: Kunal Kapoor
current_role: Chief Executive Officer and director, Morningstar, Inc. (Chicago)
profile: Kunal Kapoor, CFA, has been CEO of Morningstar, the investment research and data firm, since 2017, succeeding founder Joe Mansueto (now executive chairman). He joined Morningstar in 1997 and worked across research and data before becoming head of global products and then president (2015-2017). He sits on the board of Wealth Enhancement Group and the Council on Chicago Booth.
interesting_fact: He has spent his entire career at one firm: almost three decades at Morningstar, rising from its research group to CEO.
deep_cut_fact: His undergraduate degree from Monmouth College (Illinois) was in economics and environmental policy, a fitting background as Morningstar expanded into sustainability data via Sustainalytics.

public_contacts.value: board@morningstar.com (published for shareholder communication with the board)

notes: Regular public speaker (Morningstar conferences, financial media). Energy angle: environmental-policy degree and Morningstar's sustainability research. Route via Morningstar IR/communications.

name: Mellody L Hobson
current_role: Co-CEO and President, Ariel Investments (Chicago); director, JPMorgan Chase
profile: Mellody Hobson joined Chicago's Ariel Investments as an intern after graduating from Princeton in 1991, became president in 2000 and is now co-CEO alongside founder John Rogers Jr. She founded Ariel Alternatives and its Project Black private-equity fund in 2021 and Project Level (women's sports) in 2025, sits on JPMorgan Chase's board, and formerly chaired Starbucks and DreamWorks Animation.
interesting_fact: As Starbucks chair she became the first Black woman to chair an S&P 500 company; in 2020 she made the lead gift establishing a new residential college at Princeton.
deep_cut_fact: A long-time financial-literacy advocate, she is the author of the children's book 'Priceless Facts about Money'; she started at Ariel as an intern straight out of Princeton.
notes: Very high profile, frequent speaker and media guest; press requests go via Ariel's CMO. Entrepreneurship/PE angle via Ariel Alternatives' Project Black fund.

name: Steve Filton
current_role: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Secretary, Universal Health Services (UHS), King of Prussia, PA
profile: Steve G. Filton has spent his whole career at Universal Health Services, one of the largest US hospital and behavioral-health operators. He joined in 1985 as Director of Corporate Accounting, became Controller in 1991, Secretary in 1999, CFO in 2003 and Executive Vice President in 2017, working alongside founder Alan B. Miller.
interesting_fact: He has been with UHS for about 40 years and has been its CFO for more than two decades, an unusually long run at a large-cap company.
deep_cut_fact: He started at UHS in 1985 as Director of Corporate Accounting, and has also served as the company's corporate Secretary since 1999.
notes: Low-profile finance executive; main public exposure is UHS earnings calls. Route via UHS investor relations (contact listed in UHS earnings releases).

name: John T. Treace
current_role: Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Board Chair, Treace Medical Concepts (Nasdaq: TMCI), Ponte Vedra, FL
profile: John Treace founded Treace Medical Concepts in 2014 and has led it as CEO since inception (Board Chair since May 2025). The company makes the Lapiplasty 3D bunion-correction system. Before founding it he spent over a decade at Wright Medical Group, rising to SVP of U.S. Sales and Global Marketing, after earlier marketing roles at Xomed Surgical Products.
interesting_fact: Treace's patented Lapiplasty System for three-dimensional bunion correction has treated over 134,000 patients since late 2015; in 2025 he broadened the company into a full 'bunion solutions' business covering all four bunion classes.
deep_cut_fact: He studied finance, not medicine (BS in Finance, Seattle University), and started in med-tech as a senior product manager at Xomed Surgical Products in 1996.
notes: Med-tech founder; entrepreneurship angle but no energy/data-center link. No published press/IR email found in the proxy; check Treace's press releases for IR/media contacts.

name: Parag Mallick
current_role: Co-founder, Chief Scientist and director, Nautilus Biotechnology (Nasdaq: NAUT); Associate Professor, Stanford University
profile: Parag Mallick, PhD, co-founded Nautilus Biotechnology in 2016 with CEO Sujal Patel and serves as its Chief Scientist; Nautilus is building the Voyager single-molecule proteomics platform to count proteins and proteoforms at scale. He is an associate professor at Stanford, and previously directed clinical proteomics at Cedars-Sinai and held adjunct faculty posts at UCLA and USC.
interesting_fact: He is a computer scientist turned protein chemist: a B.S. in Computer Science from Washington University in St. Louis followed by a PhD in Chemistry and Biochemistry from UCLA, a mix that underpins Nautilus's data-heavy approach to proteomics.
deep_cut_fact: Before Stanford and Nautilus he was Director of Clinical Proteomics at Cedars-Sinai (2005-2009), after a post-doc in clinical proteomics and systems biology at the Institute for Systems Biology in Seattle.
notes: Academic-entrepreneur; data-intensive science angle. Also reachable via Stanford faculty profile (profiles.stanford.edu/parag-mallick, not retrievable during this run).

name: Eric L Veiel
current_role: Head of Global Investments and Chief Investment Officer, T. Rowe Price Group (Baltimore)
profile: Eric Veiel is T. Rowe Price's Head of Global Investments and CIO (since 2024), overseeing the firm's investment divisions. A T. Rowe vice president since 2006, he rose through equity research and portfolio leadership: Director of Equity Research North America (2014-15), Head of U.S. Equity (2016-21), Co-Head of Global Equity (2018-21) and Head of Global Equity and CIO (2022-23).
interesting_fact: He climbed from the equity-research bench to run all of T. Rowe Price's investing, one of the world's largest active asset managers, within about two decades at the firm.
notes: Senior asset-management executive; route via T. Rowe Price Media Relations. Deep-cut fact not found (web-search budget exhausted during this lane).
